conclusion: Owner-free simulation research continued immediately without waiting for future real data. Across 32 fine-sweep worlds plus independent-seed replication, broad temperature mixtures reduced worst-case regret versus frozen R0_T2. Additional PRE-degradation and severe joint-shift worlds rejected MIX_1_2_3 from the robustness frontier and identified MIX_1_15_2_3_4 / MIX_075_15_3_6 as stronger synthetic candidates. A preregistered fresh-world meta-validation then failed the retain-lead rule because the broad mix improved worst-case regret but not mean regret versus R0_T2. Using only already-consumed synthetic worlds, constrained hybrids between R0_T2 and the broad mix were developed. A second preregistered fresh-world test selected H0.25 as the current synthetic lead under the frozen rule: both H0.25 and H0.5 beat R0_T2 on max regret in both seeds and remained within the mean-regret tolerance; H0.25 had the lower average max regret. H0.25 remains simulation-only and is not real validated or promoted. R0_T2 remains unchanged for the independent prospective real confirmation lane.
